data.name: Faeem
data.gender_notes: Faeem is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Faeem is a name derived from the Arabic language and means 'fragrant, delicate, and moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often associated with purity, calmness, and the cycle of life. Naming a child Faeem is believed to bestow upon them the qualities of beauty, love, and a connection to the natural world. The name Faeem carries the meaning “Fragrant, Delicate, Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Faeem usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant, delicate, moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Faeem is a name imbued with spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is believed that the moon represents the divine feminine, and naming a child Faeem is thought to invoke the blessings of the goddesses Lakshmi and Saraswati, who are associated with beauty, prosperity, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Faeem belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant, Delicate, Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faeem total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
